1.1.title: Railway crossing with barrier
1.1.description: Warns of approaching a railway crossing with a barrier. Outside a populated area (n.p.) it is installed at a distance of 150-300 m, in a populated area - at a distance of 50-100 m. The sign can be installed at a different distance, but the distance is specified in Table 8.1.1 “Distance to the object”. The driver of a vehicle can cross railway tracks only at railway crossings, giving way to a train (locomotive, handcar). It is prohibited: a) overtaking at railway crossings and closer than 100 m in front of them; b) stopping and parking at railway crossings; c) parking closer than 50 m from railway crossings; d) turning around; e) driving in reverse; f) transporting agricultural, road, construction and other vehicles through the crossing in a non-transport position; 8 km/h, as well as tractor drag sleds without permission from the head of the track; h) drive around vehicles standing in front of a closed barrier into oncoming traffic; i) open the barrier without authorization. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.10 Part 1 Crossing a railway track outside a railway crossing, entering a railway crossing with a closed or closing barrier or with a prohibitory signal from a traffic light or the person on duty at the crossing, stopping or parking at a railway crossing or driving through an unregulated railway crossing, If a train (locomotive, handcar) approaches a crossing within sight, a fine of 5,000 rubles. or deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle for a period of 3 to 6 months;  Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.10 Part 2 Violation of the rules for passing through railway crossings, except for the cases provided for in Part 1 of this article - a fine of 5,000 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.10 Part 3 Repeated commission of an administrative offense provided for in Part 1 of this article - deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle for a period of 1 year

3.30.title: Parking is prohibited on even days of the month

3.31.title: The end of the zone of all restrictions
3.31.description: Cancels the effect of the following prohibitory signs (installed together or sequentially):1) 3.16 Minimum distance limit;2) 3.20 Overtaking prohibited;3) 3.22 Overtaking by trucks is prohibited;4) 3.24 Maximum speed limit;5) 3.26 Sound signal prohibited;6) 3.27 Stopping prohibited;7) 3.28 Parking prohibited;8) 3.29 Parking is prohibited on odd days of the month;9) 3.30 Parking is prohibited on even days of the month.

3.32.title: The movement of vehicles with dangerous goods is prohibited
3.32.description: The movement of vehicles equipped with identification signs (information plates) “Dangerous cargo” is prohibited. The sign applies to ALL vehicles that have identification marks (information plates) “Dangerous cargo”. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.16 Part 1 Failure to comply with the requirements prescribed by road signs or markings of the roadway, with the exception of the cases provided for in parts 2 - 7 of this article and other articles of this chapter - a warning or a fine of 500 rubles or Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.21.2 Part 2 Violation of the rules for the transportation of dangerous goods, except for the cases provided for in Part 1 of this articles - fine: for a driver from 1000 to 1500 rubles, for officials from 5000 to 10000 rubles, for legal entities from 150000 to 250000 rubles.

3.33.title: The movement of vehicles with explosive and flammable cargo is prohibited
3.33.description: The movement of vehicles transporting explosives and products, as well as other dangerous goods subject to marking as flammable, is prohibited, except in cases of transportation of these dangerous substances and products in limited quantities, determined in the manner established by special transportation rules. Dangerous goods are divided into classes: cl. 1 - explosives; class. 2 - compressed, liquefied and dissolved gases under pressure; class. 3 - flammable liquids; cl. 4 - flammable substances and materials; cl. 5 - oxidizing substances and organic peroxides; cl. 6 - poisonous (toxic) substances; cl. 7 - radioactive and infectious materials; class. 8 - caustic and corrosive materials; class. 9 - other hazardous substances. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.16 Part 1 Failure to comply with the requirements prescribed by road signs or markings of the roadway, with the exception of the cases provided for in parts 2 - 7 of this article and other articles of this chapter - a warning or a fine of 500 rubles or Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.21.2 Part 2 Violation of the rules for the transportation of dangerous goods, except for the cases provided for in Part 1 of this articles - fine: for a driver from 1000 to 1500 rubles, for officials from 5000 to 10000 rubles, for legal entities from 150000 to 250000 rubles.

3.34.title: Bus traffic is prohibited
3.34.description: Bus traffic is prohibited. The movement of relevant types of vehicles in both directions is prohibited. The signs do not apply to: route vehicles;	for school buses.

The following vehicles deviate from the effect of the sign: route vehicles (tram, trolleybus, bus). 4.1.5.title: Driving straight or left

4.5.5.title: Split Traffic Pedestrian & Bike Path
4.5.5.description: A bicycle and pedestrian path with a division into bicycle and pedestrian sides of the path, allocated structurally and (or) marked with horizontal markings 1.2, 1.23.2 and 1.23.3 or in another way.

4.7.description: Cancels the effect of sign 4.6 “Minimum speed limit”.

5.1.title: Motorway
5.1.description: A road on which the requirements of the Road Traffic Rules of the Russian Federation apply, establishing the procedure for driving on highways. This road is the fastest. Sign 5.1 is installed at the beginning of the highway, as well as after the entrances to it.  On the highway it is prohibited: the movement of pedestrians, persons using personal mobility devices, pets, bicycles, mopeds, tractors and self-propelled vehicles, other vehicles whose speed, according to their technical characteristics or their condition, is less than 40 km/h;	movement of trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons beyond the second lane;	stopping outside special parking areas marked with sign 6.4 or 7.11;	turning around and entering technological gaps in the median;	reversing. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.11 Part 1 Driving on a highway in a vehicle whose speed according to its technical characteristics or its condition is less than 40 kilometers per hour, as well as stopping a vehicle on a highway outside special parking areas - a fine of 1000 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.11 Part 2 Driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons on a highway beyond the second lane, as well as training driving on a highway, will result in a fine of 1,000 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.11 part 3 Turning or driving a vehicle into technological gaps in the dividing strip on a highway or driving in reverse on a highway - a fine of 2,500 rubles.

5.2.title: End of the motorway
5.2.description: Indicates the end of a motorway marked with sign 5.1. Installed at the end of the highway and at the beginning of exits from it.

5.3.title: Road for cars
5.3.description: A road intended for use only by cars, buses and motorcycles. This road is subject to all the requirements of the traffic rules section “Traffic on highways”. What is prohibited on roads marked with sign 5.1 is also prohibited on roads marked with sign 5.3. Before side entrances to a road marked with sign 5.3, sign 5.3 is installed with one of the signs 8.3.1, 8.3.2, 8.3.3 “Directions of Action”. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.11 Part 1 Driving on a highway in a vehicle whose speed according to its technical characteristics or its condition is less than 40 kilometers per hour, as well as stopping a vehicle on a highway outside special parking areas - a fine of 1000 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.11 Part 2 Driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons on a highway beyond the second lane, as well as training driving on a highway, will result in a fine of 1,000 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.11 part 3 Turning or driving a vehicle into technological gaps in the dividing strip on a highway or driving in reverse on a highway - a fine of 2,500 rubles

5.4.title: End of the road for cars
5.4.description: Indicates the end of the road marked with sign 5.3 “Road for motor vehicles”.

In cases where there are no horizontal markings dividing the roadway into the number of lanes, drivers must mentally divide its width by the number of lanes for the vehicles the driver is driving, and it is necessary that the mental lane be wide enough for the smooth movement of the vehicle. 5.6.title: End of a one way road
5.6.description: Indicates the end of a road or carriageway marked with sign 5.5 “One-way road”.

At an intersection in front of which sign 5.7.2 is installed, turning right is prohibited. U-turn is not prohibited. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.15 Part 4 Driving in violation of traffic rules onto a lane intended for oncoming traffic, or onto tram tracks in the opposite direction, except for the cases provided for in Part 3 of this article - a fine of 5,000 rubles. or deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle for a period of 4 to 6 months. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.15 Part 5 Repeated commission of an administrative offense under Part 4 of Art. 12.15 of the Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation - deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle for a period of 1 year, and in the case of recording an administrative offense using special technical means operating in automatic mode, having the functions of photography, filming, video recording, or means of photography, filming, video recording - imposition of an administrative fine in the amount of 5,000 rubles.

5.8.title: Reverse movement
5.8.description: The beginning of a section of road on which one or more lanes may change direction to the opposite direction. The direction of traffic can be reversed using reversible traffic lights. Effective area: up to sign 5.9 “End of reverse movement”.

5.9.title: End of reverse movement
5.9.description: Cancels the effect of sign 5.8 “Reverse movement”.

5.10.title: Entering a road with reverse traffic
5.10.description: The sign is used to indicate exit onto a road with reverse traffic. It is installed in front of all side exits on such a road. Drivers turning onto a reversible road marked 5.10 must drive in the far right lane. Changing lanes is allowed only after the driver is convinced that traffic in this direction is also permitted in other lanes.

5.11.1.title: Road with a lane for route vehicles
5.11.1.description: A road on which vehicles allowed to move in lanes for route vehicles move along a specially allocated lane towards the general flow of vehicles. On a road with a lane for route vehicles, marked with sign 5.11.1, the movement and stopping of other vehicles in this lane is prohibited. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.17 parts 1.1 and 1.2 Movement of vehicles in the lane for route vehicles or stopping on the specified lane in violation of the Traffic Rules - a fine of 1,500 rubles. (for Moscow and St. Petersburg - 3000 rubles)

5.12.1.title: End of the road with a lane for route vehicles
5.12.1.description: Cancels the effect of sign 5.11.1 “Road with a lane for route vehicles.”

5.12.2.title: End of the road with a lane for cyclists
5.12.2.description: The road sign is a road sign 5.11.2, the image of which is crossed out by a diagonal red stripe from the lower left corner to the upper right corner of the sign.

5.13.1.title: Entering a road with a lane for route vehicles
5.13.1.description: Entering a road with a lane for route vehicles (sign 5.11.1), the movement of which is carried out along a specially designated lane towards the general flow of vehicles. 5.14.description: The effect of the sign extends to the strip above which they are located. The effect of signs installed to the right of the road extends to the right lane.

5.15.1.title: Lane directions
5.15.1.description: The number of lanes and permitted directions of movement for each of them.  Signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2, which permit turning left from the extreme left lane, also permit a U-turn from this lane. Signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 do not apply to route vehicles. Signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 installed in front of the intersection apply to the entire intersection, if other signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 installed on it do not provide any other instructions.

5.15.2.title: Lane directions
5.15.2.description: Permitted lane directions.  Signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2, which permit turning left from the extreme left lane, also permit a U-turn from this lane. Signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 do not apply to route vehicles. Signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 installed in front of the intersection apply to the entire intersection, if other signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 installed on it do not provide any other instructions.

5.15.3.title: Start of the strip
5.15.3.description: The beginning of an additional lane on an ascent or a braking lane (for example, on a motorway before an organized parking lot). If the sign installed in front of the additional lane shows sign 4.6 “Minimum speed limit,” then the driver of a vehicle that cannot continue moving along the main lane at the indicated or higher speed must change lanes to the lane located to the right of him. Coverage area: up to sign 5.15.5 “End of lane”.

5.15.4.title: Start of the strip
5.15.4.description: The beginning of the middle section of a three-lane road intended for traffic in a given direction. Effective area: up to sign 5.15.6 “End of lane”. If sign 5.15.4 shows a sign prohibiting the movement of any vehicles, then the movement of these vehicles in the corresponding lane is prohibited.

5.15.5.title: End of the strip
5.15.5.description: The end of an additional uphill lane or acceleration lane. Cancels the effect of sign 5.15.3 “Start of lane”.

5.15.title: End of the strip
5.15.description: The end of a section of the median on a three-lane road intended for traffic in a given direction. Cancels the effect of sign 5.15.4 “Start of lane”.

5.15.7.title: Lane direction
5.15.7.description: Permitted direction of movement in lanes. If sign 5.15.7 shows a sign prohibiting the movement of any vehicles, then the movement of these vehicles in the corresponding lane is prohibited. Sign 5.15.7 with the appropriate number of arrows can be used on roads with four or more lanes.

5.15.8.title: Number of lanes
5.15.8.description: Indicates the number of lanes and lane modes. The driver is obliged to comply with the requirements of the signs marked on the arrows.

5.16.title: Bus and (or) trolleybus stop location
5.16.description: The stopping place for buses and (or) trolleybuses moving along established routes, as well as for minibuses. Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.17 Part 1 Failure to provide priority in movement to a route vehicle, as well as a vehicle with a blue flashing light and a special sound signal simultaneously turned on - a warning or a fine of 500 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.19 parts 3.1 and 6 Stopping or parking vehicles at stopping places for route vehicles or closer than 15 meters from stopping places for route vehicles, with the exception of stopping to pick up or disembark passengers, a forced stop - a fine of 1000 rubles. (for Moscow and St. Petersburg - 3000 rubles), detention of a vehicle

5.17.title: Tram stop location
5.17.description: Punishment for violating the requirements of the sign: Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.17 Part 1 Failure to provide priority in traffic to a route vehicle, as well as a vehicle with a blue flashing light and a special sound signal simultaneously turned on - a warning or a fine of 500 rubles. Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation 12.19 parts 3.1 and 6 Stopping or parking vehicles at stopping places for route vehicles or closer than 15 meters from stopping places for route vehicles, with the exception of stopping to pick up or disembark passengers, a forced stop - a fine of 1000 rubles. (for Moscow and St. Petersburg - 3000 rubles), detention of a vehicle

5.19.1.title: Pedestrian crossing
5.19.1.description: If there are no markings 1.14.1 or 1.14.2 at the crossing, sign 5.19.1 is installed to the right of the road on the near border of the crossing relative to approaching vehicles, and sign 5.19.2 is installed to the left of the road on the far border of the crossing. 8.14.title: Traffic lane
8.14.description: Indicates the traffic lane or bicycle lane covered by a sign or traffic light.

8.15.title: Blind pedestrians
8.15.description: Indicates that the pedestrian crossing is used by the blind. Used with signs 1.22, 5.19.1, 5.19.2 and traffic lights. All blind and visually impaired pedestrians move with the help of a white cane covered with reflective film. When crossing the road, they are recommended to raise the stick forward. Drivers in all cases (regardless of traffic lights) are obliged to consider this signal as a red traffic light. The driver is obliged to stop and not resume movement until the pedestrian has completed crossing the roadway in this direction.

8.16.title: Wet coating
8.16.description: Indicates that the sign applies to the period of time when the roadway surface is wet. A wet surface reduces vehicle controllability and increases braking distance. Sharp braking can cause the car's wheels to lock and drift. To avoid an accident, it is necessary to reduce speed in such places. Be especially careful when braking in places where plastic markings are applied, as well as on sections of the road at the initial moment of raindrops. When the roadway is wetted, in some cases a thin layer (dust + moisture) is formed, which further impairs the grip of the wheels on the road.
